bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (0.8, 0.02, 0.02, 1)
red.diffuse_color = (0.8, 0.02, 0.02, 1)
for i in range(1, 5):
    ob = bpy.data.objects[f"Chair {i}"]
    for s in ob.material_slots:
        s.material = red
    print(ob.name, [s.material.name for s in ob.material_slots], [s.link for s in ob.material_slots])
